**Pick Rossi Idraulica: 3,950 EUR all-in vs 4,148 EUR, with twice the warranty.**

| | Rossi (Vaillant 30 kW) | TermoCasa (Baxi 28 kW) |
|---|---|---|
| Total incl. VAT | **3,950 EUR** | 4,148 EUR |
| Warranty | 10 yrs (yearly service) | 5 yrs |
| Timing | 2 weeks | next week |

Rossi is 198 EUR cheaper, includes removing the old unit, and its warranty condition is already routine: Marta services the boiler every November anyway. TermoCasa wins only on timing, by about a week. Worth asking TermoCasa whether their price includes removing the old unit, but that only matters if you want the faster date badly enough to pay 198 EUR more for half the warranty.

Report saved to `Projects/Research/2026-10-07-2135-Boiler-Quote-Comparison.md`.
